response.sql: WITH hand_tallies AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), hand_shares AS (SELECT throws, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_tallies), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;
